items.title: Really? Palantir cofounder on AI's threat: 'We’re on top of it’
items.summary: Hysteria over the AI threat has reached a boiling point. Palantir cofounder Joe Lonsdale, however, says the "world is going to alright, guys."

items.title: Washington scrambles to meet calls for AI guardrails while the window to act closes
items.summary: The House is scheduled to be sent home in the coming days until after November's midterm elections, leaving a narrow window to pass any form of AI regulation.

items.title: Obama urges Democrats to have a ‘clear plan’ for AI safeguards
items.summary: Obama recently said that Democrats need to make artificial intelligence one of their “central agendas” and “have a very clear plan” to address concerns around the technology’s economic impact and safety.
